item.title: Joke Maximizers
item.description: Joke Maximizers Linguistic Style Punch word last funniest word at the end of the sentence Communicate the idea clearly Backload the topic Repetition Chris Rock repeats a premise thrice) Use fewer words Shorter jokes -> more jokes -> higher laughs per minute ( LPM) Brevity Language and phonetic choice Plosives Hard Consonants are “funnier” Phonetic Repetition rhyme, alliteration, etc… Make the setup Parallel to the punchline Specificity Specificity: helps visualize the hilarity Vagueness helps imply the hilarity Performance Style Be Surprising Don’t telegraph the punchline, keep it hidden Adjust your delivery to surprise (tone, volume, emotion) Prosody and Rhythm Write Tags A joke is never done, there’s always another tag Consider an Act Out i.
